entries.name: magictools
entries.asset_policy: Discovery/catalog reference only. Every downstream tool or asset retains its own license and must be reviewed independently before use.

entries.name: Material Maker
entries.asset_policy: Procedural texture-authoring workflow reference only. V0.9/V0.20 texture synthesis is implemented inside Mindforge; no Material Maker source or binary textures are copied.

entries.name: URP Shader Code Templates
entries.asset_policy: Used to cross-check URP ForwardLit, ShadowCaster and DepthOnly pass structure. Mindforge's world-space triplanar coordinates, axis blending, normal-basis conversion and distance-bounded normal sampling are project-authored; no upstream shader file is vendored.

entries.name: Quaternius production art packs
entries.license: QAL-1.0 global license page last updated 2026-08-28; individual legacy pack pages may display earlier CC0 terms
entries.asset_policy: Conservative project policy: raw Quaternius source assets are never committed to the public Mindforge repository. User-obtained packs live only under git-ignored unity/Assets/Mindforge/LocalArt and may be incorporated into built game products subject to the license version governing the obtained asset.

entries.name: Unity-Modular-Procedural-Generation
entries.asset_policy: Architectural pattern reference only; no source or binary assets copied.

entries.name: ShaderGraphExamples
entries.license: CC0-1.0 for the example ShaderGraph directory
entries.asset_policy: No ShaderGraph or binary art imported in V0.7/V0.9.

entries.name: urp-toon-shader-cyberpunk-demo
entries.asset_policy: Presentation-composition reference only; no scene, shader package or art copied.

entries.name: Unity-URP-Shaders-Code
entries.asset_policy: URP technique reference only; no shader or binary assets copied in V0.7/V0.9.

entries.name: Procedural Landmass Generation
entries.asset_policy: V0.20 adapts the deterministic octave-noise grammar for editor-authored terrain/material synthesis. No upstream scenes, textures, meshes or other binary assets are copied.

entries.name: Procedural Cave Generation
entries.asset_policy: V0.23 uses the shared visible-shell/collision-shell topology principle as an engineering reference for the cavern ceiling. Mindforge's inward height-field topology, collision reconciliation and world geometry are project-authored; no upstream scene, mesh, texture or script is copied.

entries.name: ProceduralMesh
entries.asset_policy: Mesh-recipe workflow and topology reference. Mindforge's V0.19/V0.20/V0.23 mesh implementations are project-authored; no upstream runtime package or binary art is vendored.

entries.name: NoiseShader
entries.asset_policy: Evaluated for future GPU procedural surface noise. V0.20 does not import the package or its HLSL; current world surfaces are editor-authored and use Mindforge's existing production triplanar shader.

entries.name: UnityGLTF
entries.asset_policy: V0.28 uses the pinned package only as the Unity Editor/runtime glTF importer for authored CC0 creature art. Mindforge combat, movement, collision and BCI authority do not come from UnityGLTF.

entries.name: Gobkit Free Assets
entries.asset_policy: V0.28 acquires only the pinned Rhino.glb into the ignored Generated/V28 cache, verifies the exact upstream Git blob SHA-1 before import, and uses its rig/anatomy/animation only as presentation behind Mindforge authority.

entries.name: KayKit Dungeon Remastered 1.0
entries.asset_policy: V0.28 acquires only five pinned OBJ props into the ignored Generated/V28 cache. Each upstream blob is hash-verified, its unused mtllib declaration is stripped after verification, and Mindforge cathedral materials are applied at composition time.
